_note: Repackages Kasm's prebuilt KasmVNC .deb from the public S3 (built per-distro; we take the `noble` build and autoPatchelf it against nix libs → distro-independent). These vars mirror src/ubuntu/install/kasm_vnc/install_kasm_vnc.sh; the URL is kasmvncserver_<codename>_<kasmvnc_ver>_<branch>_<commit6>_<arch>.deb (release branch omits _<branch>_<commit6>). hash is lib.fakeHash — the first `nix build` on .140 prints the real one.
